notice.context_compacted.defaultMessage: {trigger, select, manual {You compacted the context} other {Context compacted}}
notice.context_compacted.description: A divider where the agent's conversation was compacted to fit its context: by the person with /compact (manual), or by the provider on its own.

notice.conversation_item_invalid.defaultMessage: A message from the agent could not be shown.
notice.conversation_item_invalid.description: The adapter produced an item outside the protocol's limits.

notice.core_decoding_failed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not read part of the agent's output.
notice.core_decoding_failed.description: The provider adapter could not decode a chunk.

notice.core_link_unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo could not read the agent's output for a moment. The agent keeps working.
notice.core_link_unavailable.description: The resident Lervo process was unreachable while decoding.

notice.provider_turn_failed.defaultMessage: The agent's turn ended without finishing ({subtype}).
notice.provider_turn_failed.description: Claude Code's result did not succeed.

notice.start.coordination_unavailable.defaultMessage: This work writes without claiming its paths, because Lervo could not set up its coordination ({code}).
notice.start.coordination_unavailable.description: A Lervo notice at the top of new work when the core could not create the conversation's assignment or workspace record, so other conversations are not kept from its paths; {code} is the failed step's code.

notice.start.hire_failed.defaultMessage: This work started without a Product Owner, because Lervo could not hire one ({code}).
notice.start.hire_failed.description: A Lervo notice at the top of new work when the Product Owner the start card proposed could not be hired; {code} is the protocol code.

notice.turn_stopped.defaultMessage: You stopped the agent's turn. Send a message to continue.
notice.turn_stopped.description: The person stopped the agent's turn; the conversation goes on.

notice.unknown.description: A Lervo notice without a catalog message.

notice.workspace_base.base_unresolved.defaultMessage: This work started from the checked-out commit, because the repository names no default branch.
notice.workspace_base.base_unresolved.description: A Lervo notice above the working line after a start: the core found no default branch.

notice.workspace_base.fetch_failed.defaultMessage: This work started from your local default branch, which may be behind, because {upstream} could not be fetched.
notice.workspace_base.fetch_failed.description: A Lervo notice above the working line after a start: the upstream fetch failed. {upstream} is a ref such as origin/main.

notice.workspace_base.knowledge_state_un.defaultMessage: This work started without Lervo's unpublished knowledge commits, because their publication state could not be read.
notice.workspace_base.knowledge_state_un.description: A Lervo notice above the working line after a start: the core could not tell which knowledge commits to carry.

notice.workspace_base.no_upstream.defaultMessage: This work started from your local default branch, which follows no remote branch.
notice.workspace_base.no_upstream.description: A Lervo notice above the working line after a start: the default branch has no upstream.

notice.workspace_base.replay_incomplete.defaultMessage: This work started without Lervo's unpublished knowledge commits, because they did not apply cleanly.
notice.workspace_base.replay_incomplete.description: A Lervo notice above the working line after a start: the core dropped the replay of its knowledge commits.

notice.workspace_base.unknown.defaultMessage: This work started with the notice {code}.
notice.workspace_base.unknown.description: A Lervo notice above the working line after a start, for a notice code the interface does not know.

projects.sheet.clone.field.description: Label of the Clone Repository window's link field.

projects.sheet.clone.subtitle.defaultMessage: Lervo clones it and adds it as a project.
projects.sheet.clone.subtitle.description: The line under the Clone Repository window's title.

projects.sheet.clone.title.description: Title of the window that clones a repository as a project.

projects.sheet.failed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not add the project ({code}).
projects.sheet.failed.description: Adding a project failed; {code} is the protocol code.

projects.sheet.location.description: Label of the folder the project goes into.

room.answeredElsewhere.description: A room line in a conversation for a turn its lead took in another conversation, answering an agent that mentioned it there; the title opens that conversation.

room.answeredElsewhereUnlisted.description: A room line for a turn the lead took in another conversation that is not listed here.

room.claimConflict.defaultMessage: {agent} was stopped at {path} · {holder} holds it in {title}
room.claimConflict.description: A room line after a tool call Lervo stopped: another conversation's agent holds the path; the title opens that conversation.

room.claimConflictHeld.description: A room line after a tool call Lervo stopped, when the holder's conversation is not listed here.

room.claimDeferred.defaultMessage: Lervo checks this turn's claims at its end ({code})
room.claimDeferred.description: A room line, once per turn, when Lervo could not decide a write's claim in time and let it go ahead; {code} is the reason's code.

room.claimRefused.description: A room line after a tool call Lervo stopped for a reason no agent holds, such as a path outside the lead's responsibility; {reason} is the core's code.

room.claimUnresolved.description: A room line at a turn's end for a path the turn changed that another conversation holds; the title opens that conversation.

room.claimUnresolvedCode.description: A room line at a turn's end for a path the turn changed that Lervo could not claim for a reason no agent holds; {reason} is the core's code.

room.claimUnresolvedHeld.description: A room line at a turn's end for a path another agent holds, when the holder's conversation is not listed here.

room.claimUnresolvedMore.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# more path stays unresolved} other {# more paths stay unresolved}}
room.claimUnresolvedMore.description: A room line after the first unresolved paths of a turn, counting the rest.

room.claimUnresolvedUnverified.defaultMessage: {path} stays unresolved · Lervo could not check it in time
room.claimUnresolvedUnverified.description: A room line at a turn's end for a path the turn changed that Lervo could not check in time (claim_unverified).

room.claimUnverified.defaultMessage: {agent} was stopped at {path} · Lervo could not check it in time
room.claimUnverified.description: A room line after a tool call Lervo stopped because it could not check the path's claim in time (claim_unverified); nothing was written, and the agent can retry.

room.deliveryFailed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not deliver a mention ({code}).
room.deliveryFailed.description: A room line: a mention could not reach the mentioned agent; {code} is the core's code.

room.conversationStarted.description: A room line: an agent started a conversation of its own for work that belongs apart; the title opens it.

room.conversationStartedBy.description: A room line at the top of a conversation an agent started; the title opens the conversation it was started in.

room.conversationStartedByElsewhere.description: A room line at the top of a conversation an agent started, when the conversation it was started in is gone.

room.joined.description: A room line: an agent joined the conversation because another agent mentioned it.

room.paused.defaultMessage: Agents paused at {limit} turns in 10 minutes. The agent that started the exchange summarizes it; reply to start again.
room.paused.description: A room line: agent-to-agent mentions reached the exchange budget.

room.rejoinFailed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not reopen an agent's session here ({code}).
room.rejoinFailed.description: A room line: a joined agent's session could not be resumed when the conversation opened; {code} is the protocol code.

room.workSent.description: A room line: an agent sent work to a conversation a teammate already leads; the title opens it.

room.workSentFrom.description: A room line before work another agent sent to this conversation; the title opens the conversation it came from.

start.error.application_unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo is not reachable on this computer.

start.keptChanges.copied.description: The copy button's words once the restore command is on the clipboard.

workspace.branch.copied.description: The line beside the header's branch icon for a few seconds after pressing it copied the branch name.

workspace.retire.action.description: The accessible name of the header's trash button, which removes the selected workspace.

workspace.retire.cancel.description: Answers the remove question: keeps the workspace.

workspace.retire.confirm.description: Answers the remove question: stops the session and removes the workspace.

workspace.retire.failed.other.defaultMessage: The workspace could not be removed ({code}).
workspace.retire.failed.other.description: Removing failed for a reason without its own text; code names it.

workspace.retire.failed.session_stop_tim.defaultMessage: The session did not stop in time. Try again.
workspace.retire.failed.session_stop_tim.description: Removing stopped the session, but it did not end within 15 seconds.

workspace.retire.failed.workspace_change.defaultMessage: Lervo could not keep a copy of the changes, so it removed nothing.
workspace.retire.failed.workspace_change.description: Removing with changes refused because the copy of the changes could not be made.

workspace.retire.failed.workspace_nested.defaultMessage: A nested repository or submodule here has work Lervo cannot keep. Commit and push it, or remove it, first.
workspace.retire.failed.workspace_nested.description: Removing with changes refused because a nested repository or submodule holds commits or changes a copy cannot hold.

workspace.retire.failed.workspace_has_ch.description: Removing refused because the workspace holds uncommitted changes or new files.

workspace.retire.failed.workspace_integr.defaultMessage: A change from this workspace is waiting to be integrated. Remove it after it integrates.
workspace.retire.failed.workspace_integr.description: Removing refused because a sealed change from the workspace's conversation still waits for integration; nothing changed.

workspace.retire.failed.workspace_in_use.defaultMessage: A process still runs in this workspace. Stop it and try again.
workspace.retire.failed.workspace_in_use.description: Removing refused because a process works in the workspace's folder.

workspace.retire.failed.workspace_worktr.defaultMessage: This workspace's folder was moved or switched to another branch. Remove that folder, then try again.
workspace.retire.failed.workspace_worktr.description: Removing refused because the conversation's checkout is still on disk or registered with Git but is no longer its worktree; nothing was released.

workspace.retire.question.description: The question in the header after the trash button; the worktree and, when merged, its branch leave.

workspace.retire.questionWithChanges.defaultMessage: Remove it with its changes? Lervo keeps them, not ignored files, for up to 14 days.
workspace.retire.questionWithChanges.description: The question after Remove with changes: the core keeps a copy of the uncommitted changes, without ignored files, for up to 14 days and among the newest 10 copies, before it removes the worktree.

workspace.retire.withChanges.description: Beside the refusal for uncommitted changes: asks to remove the workspace with them.

workspace.retire.removing.description: In place of the remove question: the core is removing the worktree and its branch.

workspace.retire.stopping.description: In place of the remove question: the workspace's agent session is ending before the workspace is removed.

workspaces.conversations.description: The sidebar section heading above the selected project's conversations, shown with the agents.

workspaces.label.description: Accessible name of the workspace list.

workspaces.new.description: The row that opens the start screen.

workspaces.new.key.description: The key that, with the command modifier, opens the start screen.

workspaces.status.needsYou.description: Status text for assistive technology: the workspace needs the user.

workspaces.status.working.description: Status text for assistive technology: the agent is working.

workspaces.unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo could not load the workspaces ({code}). It tries again on the next connection.
workspaces.unavailable.description: The workspace list could not reload; {code} is the protocol code.

workspaces.changeFailed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not change the conversation ({code}).
workspaces.changeFailed.description: One line in the sidebar when renaming or pinning a conversation failed; code is the stable failure code.

workspaces.menu.pin.description: Context menu item of a conversation: keep it at the top of the list.

workspaces.menu.rename.description: Context menu item of a conversation: edit its title in place.

workspaces.menu.unpin.description: Context menu item of a pinned conversation: return it to its place in the list.

workspaces.rename.description: The conversation's title in its header, which renames it in place when pressed.

workspaces.rename.label.description: Accessible label of the field that edits a conversation's title in place.

agents.hire.newRole.description: The last item of the hire menu: hires an agent for a role the project adds first.

agents.hire.newRole.detail.defaultMessage: A role this project needs, started from a template
agents.hire.newRole.detail.description: One quiet line under New Role in the hire menu.

agents.sheet.hire.title.description: The title of the sheet that hires an agent.

agents.sheet.hire.subtitle.defaultMessage: Name them like a person, such as Bora. Their role says what they do.
agents.sheet.hire.subtitle.description: One line under the hire sheet's title: the name is a nickname, and the specialty belongs in the role.

agents.sheet.name.description: The label of the hire sheet's name field.

agents.sheet.name.placeholder.description: The hint in the empty name field: a person-like nickname. Lervo picks one when the field stays empty.

agents.sheet.role.description: The label of the hire sheet's role menu.

agents.sheet.role.new.description: The last choice of the hire sheet's role menu: adds a role before hiring.

agents.sheet.roleName.description: The label of a role's name field, in the hire sheet and the role sheet.

agents.sheet.roleName.placeholder.description: The hint in the empty role name field: a specialty, never a person's name.

agents.sheet.roleDescription.description: The label of a role's description field.

agents.sheet.roleDescription.placeholder.defaultMessage: Owns machining feasibility and reviews every toolpath.
agents.sheet.roleDescription.placeholder.description: The hint in the empty role description field: what the role owns and decides.

agents.sheet.from.description: The label of the menu that picks the template a new role extends.

agents.sheet.cancel.description: Closes an agent sheet without changing anything.

agents.sheet.hire.hiring.description: What Lervo is doing while the hire sheet waits for the core.

agents.sheet.failed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not hire the agent ({code}).
agents.sheet.failed.description: One line in the hire sheet when adding the role or hiring failed; code is the stable failure code.

agents.sheet.role.edit.description: Opens the sheet of a role the project wrote itself, from the hire sheet.

agents.sheet.role.title.description: The title of a project role's sheet.

agents.sheet.role.subtitle.defaultMessage: Changes apply to every agent with this role, from their next session.
agents.sheet.role.subtitle.description: One line under the role sheet's title.

agents.sheet.role.saving.description: What Lervo is doing while a role's change waits for the core.

agents.sheet.role.remove.description: Removes the project role; the core refuses one that an agent or open work still holds.

agents.sheet.role.removing.description: What Lervo is doing while a role's removal waits for the core.

agents.sheet.role.failed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not change the role ({code}).{code, select, role_in_use { Move its agents to another role first.} role_extended { Another role starts from it; change that role first.} role_name_conflict { Another role has that name.} other {}}
agents.sheet.role.failed.description: One line in the role sheet when a change or removal failed; code is the stable failure code, and a known code adds its next step.

agents.profile.role.description: The heading of the role section in an agent's profile, and the label of its role menu.

agents.profile.role.edit.description: Opens the sheet of the agent's role, for a role the project wrote itself.

agents.profile.role.note.defaultMessage: Choosing another role pauses the agent for a moment. Its name and what it learned stay.
agents.profile.role.note.description: Under the role menu in an agent's profile.

lervo.command.role.add.description: What Lervo did when the agent ran `lervo role add`, as a quiet line in the conversation.

lervo.command.role.edit.description: What Lervo did when the agent ran `lervo role edit`, as a quiet line in the conversation.

lervo.command.role.remove.description: What Lervo did when the agent ran `lervo role remove`, as a quiet line in the conversation.
